title: BT Studio
summary: BLE 5.2 & Classic radar, GATT Grade A-F, Honeypot, BTSnoop & 4-Model ML
description: BT Studio is a non-root Bluetooth 5.2 BLE & Classic engineering lab for CardputerZero: live radar with Tap-to-Select, Learn My Room (NEW ONLY) baseline, anti-stalking RPA Tracker Guard, Kalman Foxhunt, passive IoT sensors (BTHome/Xiaomi/Ruuvi/Govee), GATT Explorer & Security Grade (A-F), live Notify Byte-Diff, GATT Honeypot clone, BLE NUS & Classic SPP terminal, Wireshark BTSnoop export, 4 embedded Pure-Go INT8 neural models (BTDeviceNet v2, BLEPayloadNet-1D, BTSeqNet-1D, BTAnomalyAE), and opt-in 31-tool MCP.
